about: The unchanged nodemailer at Rallly's pin (^10.0.1, packages/emails/package.json at 3e63239dbdec) builds Rallly's SMTP transport from the SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT and SMTP_SECURE the World injects (no SMTP_USER or SMTP_PWD: the relay at boot asks no authentication), verifies it (EHLO, QUIT) and sends a finalized poll's invitation with html, text, reply-to, List-Unsubscribe headers and its calendar event to two recipients, asserting both accepted, none rejected and the data answered 250.

retention.none: SMTP gives a client no command that reads accepted mail back (RFC 5321: the relay takes a message and answers 250, nothing more), and the applications read none back; the relay hands each message on to the recipient's mailbox provider (ADR 0032), where the person reads it.
